description: The signed-in traveller's travel preferences, as set in the Meridian Dispatch app (How you like to travel): how much they like each kind of travel (coast, old towns, ancient sites, nature, scenic drives, big cities, hiking, museums, food, nightlife, snow, wellness: love, like, sometimes or not for me), the stays they like, their hotel level (budget, mid-range, luxury, ultra luxury: a level in words, never a price) and where their hotels sit (old town, beach, countryside...), their pace (one base, a few bases, always moving), how far a trip goes (stay put, a region, cover ground) and how they get around (drive, trains, a mix), the shape of their days (packed or unhurried, early or late starts, evenings), how they fly (direct, connecting, stopovers) and in which cabin, the airport they fly from (with its IATA code, the other nearby airports they use, and the city code such as NYC or LON when any airport in that city will do), whether they choose main cities or go deep into a country, whether they want new places or old favourites, and the countries they have been to (ISO codes). Worked out in the app from what they actually did, or set by them. Use it to pick bases and hotels at their level, size a day to their pace, route a trip the way they travel, start and end the flights at their home airport, and tell new countries from ones they know. Needs sign-in.
name: get_travel_preferences
title: Get my travel preferences
